parsed.title: AOL Ad-Free Sprint
parsed.oneLiner: Enjoy 15 minutes of ad-free news reading after a quick game.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e42)
AD TODAY banner on Article Ad View (e17)

newMechanic.name: Ad-free Sprint
newMechanic.description: A time-boxed entitlement that suppresses all native and banner advertisements across news feeds and article pages.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The app is currently high-density in advertisements but lacks a scarcity-based value exchange to drive engagement or sample premium benefits.

parsed.trigger: User opens the Account Menu Sidebar and views account options.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying users currently exposed to standard ad density.

offer.title: Go Ad-Free for 15 Minutes
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to clear all ads from your news feed for a short sprint.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 15 minutes, serving as a 'taste of premium' sampling effect rather than a permanent replacement for ad-free tiers.
risks: Users may grow accustomed to ad-free reading and find the return to standard density jarring.
Potential revenue dip if sprint sessions overlap with peak reading times.

newElements.change: A menu item with a lightning icon titled 'Ad-Free Sprint (15 min)' and a 'Play to Start' subtitle.
A small countdown timer badge next to the 'Home' title indicating remaining ad-free time.

storyboard.caption: The user explores the sidebar menu where news and account settings are managed.
A new 'Ad-Free Sprint' entry point is added to the menu, offering a premium benefit for attention.

callouts.text: User taps to see the value exchange.

storyboard.caption: Simula MiniGameInvitation appears, disclosing the 15-second requirement and the 15-minute reward.
The user plays a quick 15-second game with the AOL Game Partner character.
The reward is granted; ads are hidden from the feed and a countdown timer confirms the sprint status.
